stem_book: In the figure an object of mass M is kept on a rough table. Two forces are applied on it in the plane of the table: 20 N along one direction and 15 N perpendicular to it. The object does not move. Find the magnitude (in N) and direction of the static friction.
key: 25 N, opposite to the resultant F r
correct_answer: 25 N, opposite to the resultant of the two forces (at tan⁻¹(3/4) = 37° to the reverse of the 20 N force)
reason: Print asks only the direction; magnitude added (as in the manifest) so it has a checkable value.
